twoFactorAuthentication.title: Two-step verification
twoFactorAuthentication.description: We recommend requiring a verification code in addition to your password to protect your account.
twoFactorAuthentication.toggleAuthenticatorApp: Turn the authenticator app on or off
twoFactorAuthentication.setupDescription: Scan this code in your authenticator app to link your account.
twoFactorAuthentication.setupPending: The QR code will be available when secure setup is ready.
twoFactorAuthentication.setupReady: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app. You will be asked to confirm it with a code next.
twoFactorAuthentication.qrCodeLabel: Unique QR code for authenticator app setup
twoFactorAuthentication.verificationCodeHelp: Enter the six-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
twoFactorAuthentication.invalidVerificationCode: The code is not valid. Try again.
twoFactorAuthentication.verificationUnavailable: We could not complete verification. Generate a new QR code and try again.
twoFactorAuthentication.recoveryCodesDescription: Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
twoFactorAuthentication.verificationCodePending: Enter the six-digit code after scanning the QR code.
